transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

Ever since they changed my job around, I’ve sunk into this deep, heavy sadness that I just can’t shake, and it’s getting harder to do anything. It just feels like there's this constant weight on me, and I can't seem to get myself going at all anymore.
Have you lost interest in activities you used to enjoy, or do you still find pleasure in things, even if you feel sad?

I've completely lost interest in the things I used to love, like my woodworking projects or going out on the lake with the guys. Now, even the thought of doing any of that feels pointless and exhausting, so I just end up sitting and staring at the TV without really watching it.
Have you felt this lack of interest or pleasure in almost all activities nearly every day for at least two weeks?

Yes, it's actually been going on for about three months now, which is way longer than just two weeks. I've completely stopped doing my woodworking or going out on the lake with my friends because everything just feels pointless and exhausting. Most days, I just sit and stare at the TV without even registering what's on.
Have you been feeling excessively guilty, worthless, or like you're a burden to others during this time?

I feel like a complete failure who is constantly screwing everything up, especially since my sister has to drive all the way down here to clean my messy apartment and help me pay my bills. It makes me feel like such a heavy burden to her. I even keep hearing my old district manager's voice telling me what a failure I am and that everyone is laughing at me.
